name.en-US: Thirty Questions on the Book of Kings
name.pt-BR: Trinta Questões sobre o Livro dos Reis

description.la: Triginta quaestiones in librum Regum, ad Nothelmum presbyterum.
description.en-US: Bede's answers to thirty questions on difficult passages of the Books of Kings, put to him by the priest Nothelm (later Archbishop of Canterbury). Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: As respostas de Beda a trinta questões sobre passagens difíceis dos Livros dos Reis, propostas pelo presbítero Nothelm (depois arcebispo de Cantuária).

sources.edition: Quaestiones in libros Regum on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
